description: Berlin publishes citywide 3D building models as open data. The LoD2 dataset from the Senate Department for Urban Development, Building and Housing contains the three-dimensional building models of the whole of Berlin, with footprints that match the building outlines in the property cadastre and roofs as generalised standard roof shapes; a LoD1 block model is also published. Separately, the Senate Department for Economics, Energy and Public Enterprises and the Business Location Center offer a textured 3D mesh model of the whole state area, derived from a multi-perspective flight in June 2025 and including BER airport, as free OBJ tiles with textures. Coverage: the Land of Berlin. Access: an ATOM download service listed on GovData for LoD2, and the Berlin 3D download portal for mesh tiles. Licence: Datenlizenz Deutschland Zero 2.0 for LoD2; the mesh portal has its own terms; free. Caveats: the daten.berlin.de catalogue returned 403 here, so the LoD2 details come from its GovData copy; the mesh has no building semantics. Simulation uses are solar and shading analysis, urban climate and flood modelling, and a base for Berlin digital twins. Related records: the national LoD2-DE record and the OGC CityGML standard.
